payload.title: International shipping, duties and returns
payload.body_html:
We ship to Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany and Australia. Prices are shown in your currency. Duties and import taxes are included in the price you pay at checkout, so there is nothing to pay on delivery.

Shipping: Canada CAD 25.95, free over CAD 205; United Kingdom GBP 19.95, free over GBP 165; Germany EUR 29.95, free over EUR 240; Australia AUD 50.95, free over AUD 415.

Returns are accepted within 30 days from every country we ship to. Duties and taxes paid at checkout are refunded when a whole order is returned; return shipping is paid by the buyer.
